summary_for_children: Al-'Alaq means The Clinging Substance. Its first ayahs were the first revelation: Recite in the name of your Lord who created, who taught by the pen.
world_title: Recite! The Pen and the Clinging Substance
environment_concept: A quiet mountain cave mouth at night with a single line of light, then a scriptorium where the pen teaches; the first revelation is only told, never shown.
architecture_and_scenery: A rocky hill with a cave entrance, a writing room with pens and tablets.

areas.name: Hill of Revelation
areas.description: A hill with a cave mouth, empty.
